newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Two female rebels die in latest Colombian clashes.
newsitem.headline: Two female rebels die in latest Colombian clashes.

text.p: Two female guerrilla fighters were killed in clashes with the army in a jungle region of southeast Colombia on Sunday, according to radio reports.

The firefight between counterinsurgency troops and members of the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC), the country's largest and oldest leftist rebel force, took place near the town of San Jose del Guaviare, in Guaviare province.

Gen. Alfonso Espina, who headed the military operation, told the Caracol radio network that other insurgents were wounded in the fighting but were dragged off into the jungle by their colleagues. No army casualties were reported.
